limitations.text: 么 is recorded both as a variant associated with 幺 and as the standardized simplified counterpart of 麽, but the evidence does not establish how their shapes are historically related. The available image shows 幺 in a modern seal-style reconstruction; it illustrates 幺’s role in the transmitted analysis of 麽, not the formation or history of 么, so it does not clarify this character’s graphic history.
